prompts.name: wet
prompts.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: transparent 512x512 standalone hand gesture illustration for a cozy pet grooming game's first-customer tutorial. Style: same family as existing UI icons: bold smooth dark charcoal outline #30303e, chunky rounded shapes, restrained soft pastel shading, bright yellow rubber glove #ffda39 with pale highlights, cream fur, sky-blue water #72cbed, coral motion arrows #f28b60. Clear at 100 pixels, centered generous transparent margin. No text, lettering, digits, logos, border, background, or whole UI. Only one unified instructional pictogram. Existing grooming tool icons will be reused separately by the game: do not draw a shower, bottle, bucket, folded towel icon, or dryer. Show a yellow rubber-gloved pointing hand sweeping left-to-right across a short cream-colored curved patch of dog fur, three large blue droplets above, a broad CORAL horizontal zigzag arrow across the fur. Meaning: hold and sweep to wet the body. Glove in lower-right, wide sweep path clearly visible.
